turns.text: Send payment reminders to everyone who is overdue, and tell me what our receivables look like.

{"sql": "
SELECT i.invoice_no, i.customer_no, c.name, c.email, i.issued_on, i.due_on, i.amount, i.status,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) as paid,
       i.amount - COALESCE(SUM(p.amount),0) as balance,
       julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) as days_overdue
FROM erp_invoices i
LEFT JOIN erp_payments p ON p.invoice_no = i.invoice_no
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = i.customer_no
GROUP BY i.invoice_no
HAVING balance > 0.01
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC
"}
turns.name: run_sql

turns.text:
{"sql": "
WITH bal AS (
  SELECT i.invoice_no, i.customer_no, c.name, c.email, i.due_on, i.amount,
         i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no=i.invoice_no),0) as balance,
         julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) as days_overdue
  FROM erp_invoices i
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = i.customer_no
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) as n_open_invoices,
  SUM(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 THEN balance ELSE 0 END) as total_ar,
  SUM(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 AND days_overdue>0 THEN balance ELSE 0 END) as total_overdue,
  SUM(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 AND days_overdue>0 AND days_overdue<=90 THEN balance ELSE 0 END) as overdue_le90,
  SUM(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 AND days_overdue>90 THEN balance ELSE 0 END) as overdue_gt90,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 AND days_overdue>0 AND days_overdue<=90 THEN 1 END) as n_le90,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN balance>0.01 AND days_overdue>90 THEN 1 END) as n_gt90
FROM bal;
"}
turns.name: run_sql

SELECT c.customer_no, c.name, SUM(i.amount) as revenue
FROM erp_invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no=i.customer_no
GROUP BY c.customer_no, c.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;
"}

{"sql": "
SELECT i.invoice_no, i.customer_no, c.name,
       i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no=i.invoice_no),0) as balance,
       CAST(julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) AS INTEGER) as days_overdue
FROM erp_invoices i
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_no = i.customer_no
WHERE i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM erp_payments p WHERE p.invoice_no=i.invoice_no),0) > 0.01
  AND julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) > 0
  AND julianday('2026-09-29') - julianday(i.due_on) <= 90
ORDER BY days_overdue DESC;
"}
